basic_info.description: Charming Victorian home with detached rear cottage on a 122-foot deep lot, set on a coveted street along the northwest slope of Bernal Heights. Behind its cheerful facade, this entertainer's dream offers a bright living room with pocket doors to a double parlor/bedroom, formal dining room, remodeled kitchen, and a primary suite with a spacious en-suite bath. Period details blend harmoniously with modern updates including refinished hardwood floors, soaring 11 ceilings, and contemporary lighting. Garage with 1 car parking and washer/dryer complete the main home. Enjoy a smooth transition of indoor-outdoor living in the deep, verdant east-facing garden designed by Janet Moyer Landscaping. A walk-out bluestone patio and lush plantings leads to the recently renovated rear studio cottage, perfect for a creative retreat, guests, or even potential rental income. Ideally located, this home offers easy access to Cortland Avenue and Mission Street shops and cafes, plus nearby Holly, Precita, and Bernal Heights Parks. With tech shuttle stops, BART, and freeway access close at hand, this is Bernal Heights living at its finest.
